name: cars_civil_c1_zones
prompt:
The attached image is a finished sheet of top-down car sprites for a 2D city game, on flat magenta. Every car points to the right: nose on the right, tail on the left.

Make the same image as a zone map: keep every car exactly where it is, at exactly its size, outline and shape, and repaint each part of it as one flat, solid colour. No shading, no highlights, no texture, no outlines, no anti-aliasing: hard edges between zones.

Zone colours:
- Bodywork (every painted panel, roof, bonnet, boot, bumpers, mirrors): pure white #FFFFFF.
- Every window and glass roof: pure black #000000.
- Each tail lamp lens: pure red #FF0000.
- Each amber indicator lens: pure yellow #FFFF00.
- Each headlamp lens: pure blue #0000FF.
- Chrome trim, grille, rails and handles: mid grey #808080.

Rules:
- Each lamp zone covers exactly the lens drawn in the original, in its own shape and size, in the same place. Do not move, enlarge, merge or add any lamp. Every lamp lens in the original gets its zone.
- The background stays flat pure magenta #FF00FF. Nothing outside the cars changes.
- No text, no labels, no legend.
